name: username-field
title: Username field
description: A handle field with an @ prefix, the rules stated in words and an availability check you supply, so people know a name is free before they submit.
docs: Give it onCheck(username, { signal }) and it asks once typing has paused for debounce ms (400 by default): return true or false, or { available, suggestions } with up to three names that are free. Pass the signal to fetch so a question for an older name is cancelled; an answer for an older name is thrown away either way. onStatusChange(status, username) says when the name is available, for example to enable a submit button. reserved takes names that are refused without asking, and RESERVED_USERNAMES in username-field/usernames is a starting list. Without onCheck the field only checks the format and calls nothing.
